rules.notes: Intigriti bounty table coarse-grained — only min/max range known from dump; refine from program Rewards tab if drafting against medium/low severity. tacRequired: False (no special T&C acceptance gate beyond platform standard). twoFactorRequired: False (no 2FA requirement on platform side noted in dump). safe_harbor: defaulted to False — Intigriti safe-harbor language is in the program policy text, not the dump; read the program page before drafting. mass_scanning_allowed: defaulted to False (not stated in dump; safe default). bucket_download_allowed: defaulted to False (not stated in dump; safe default). automated_tools_allowed: defaulted to False (not stated in dump; safe default). cve_age_min_days: defaulted to 30 (not stated in dump; safe default). requires_ownership_proof: defaulted to True (not stated in dump; safe default). per-asset severity_cap mapped from Tier 1/2/3 to critical/high/medium; 46 entries have null impact and are defaulted to unknown — refine from Rewards tab before drafting. submission_form is best-guess URL pattern; confirm by reading the program page once before pasting. Scope spans multiple A.S. Watson retail brands across Asia and Europe: Watsons (HK, TH, TW, SG, PH, MY, ID, VN, TR), Park N Shop / PNS (HK), Fortress (HK), LookAtMe (PH), Drogas (LT, LV), Moneyback (HK). No out-of-scope entries listed in dump — treat unlisted subdomains as potentially in-scope under wildcards but confirm with program rules page before testing.
